name: jedisct1/libsodium
description: A modern, portable, easy-to-use cryptographic library providing encryption, decryption, digital signatures, and secure password hashing. A portable fork of NaCl with broad language binding support including JavaScript/WebAssembly.
score_rationale: Essential modern crypto library with 13.5k stars, widely adopted for its simplicity and resistance to misuse compared to lower-level alternatives like OpenSSL.
